backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with storage, authorization mixins, and all core data types for users, rituals, stats, love languages, challenges, and related domain models.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to affected files, components, and test IDs with high-confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend source files describing their purpose, UI behavior, and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes with color tokens and layout defaults.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags, icons, theme‑initialization script, and React root mounting point.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist documenting expected behaviors, test steps, and verification criteria for major app features and UI flows.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app logic handling authentication, profile loading, error states, tab navigation, and landing‑vs‑app mode switching.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a bottom navigation bar with icons and highlights the active tab. Handles tab changes via button clicks.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Generates floating heart animations using randomized positions and delays. Displays animated hearts across the screen.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides loading, empty, error, and section header UI components. Includes retry actions, icons, and optional details.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Displays current harmony score, trend indicators, and a sparkline chart. Shows explanations or fallback messaging when insufficient data exists.
Shows a compact harmony score with trend indicator. Acts as a button that navigates to the insights page.
frontend/src/components/LandingBrand.tsx: Renders the app brand logo with fallback text if image loading fails. Supports default and compact display variants.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Shows modal dialogs for about, contact, terms, privacy, or investor info. Content varies by selected footer link.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Displays a rotating phone mockup with selectable screenshots. Includes dot controls for switching images.
Shows preview or full founder story text with expandable toggle. Uses paragraphs from imported story content.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: Image carousel with auto‑rotation, manual navigation buttons, dot indicators, and phone mockup display.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading state handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Placeholder card announcing upcoming love challenges with icons and styled messaging.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Interactive card showing love‑language status, primary action button, and shortcut to insights.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Profile setup form collecting a user name, handling validation, loading, and success states.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays placeholder progress UI with heart‑shaped progress graphic, milestones, and progress bar.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Spin‑the‑wheel component selecting a love language with animated rotation and daily spin tracking.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Theme toggle button switching between light and dark modes via useTheme hook.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Defines love‑language activity packs with unlock requirements and a component for selecting and displaying them based on streak and quiz state.
frontend/src/content/contact.ts: Exports the app’s contact email constant.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Exports a narrative string describing the app’s origin story.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Provides a theme context managing light/dark/system modes with persistence and system‑theme syncing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for login, logout, and identity state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Hook that tracks the user’s prefers‑reduced‑motion media setting.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, rituals, media, and partner/quiz state using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSectionEntrance.ts: Hook using IntersectionObserver to reveal sections when entering viewport, respecting reduced‑motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re‑exports the useTheme hook for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables, utility classes, and animations for a romantic-styled UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point configuring React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Displays user activities, gating access based on authentication and pairing, with challenges, rewards, and a spin wheel.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page managing daily ritual flow, history display, media upload, and love‑language‑based visuals.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Insights dashboard showing streaks, harmony metrics, quiz alignment, trends, and badge milestones.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Public landing page with hero sections, animations, feature previews, and onboarding entry.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Implements the Love Languages quiz UI, mapping values between UI and backend and handling quiz state, submission, and rendering questions/results.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays a list of ritual memory entries with expandable details, formatting dates and mapping love-language metadata for each entry.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Manages user pairing, profile checks, admin state, and combined quiz results, providing UI for entering or generating pairing codes and showing relationship insights.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helpers for harmony trend calculations, including percent conversion, series normalization, and trend labeling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, supporting both query and hash routing with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration, including theme extensions, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, features, issues, and new feature requests for the GrowInLove app.
